proved_implication: For R=X^T M Y+alpha^T X+G(Y), r>=2 and S_r(M)>0 imply ||p_R||inf <= sqrt(2) C_RV r/((r-1)S_r(M)). For full Q with original split I,J,K, A_II=0, B=A_IJ, this gives ||p_Q||inf <= (C_RV/sqrt(2)) r/((r-1)S_r(B)); in particular sqrt(2)C_RV/dist_HS(B,rank<=2).
